examples.pie: kʷím moy príHe h₂éḱmō gʷélh₁t? HréwdHt kʷis. téwe h₂éwh₂osyo ḱwónm̥ kélh₂t. ḱwṓ dréh₂t téwe-kʷe te h₂éwh₂os wrégeti. ḱwṓ néḱus? h₁éy ne néḱus HréwdHti. nu éti dréh₂oh₂. dr̥h₂dʰí. ǵérh₂onts gʰrémeti.

examples.en: Husband, where is your stone? It lies in the river. Did you not throw it to the other side? I threw it, but it slipped from my hand. Now the fish will swim around it. Do not laugh, wife! I do not laugh. I love you when another man beats you.
